product_metadata.title: Kashi Home 3 Piece Blackout Kitchen Curtain Set, Energy Efficient , Rod Pocket Window Treatment, Beth (Turquoise)
features: 3-piece kitchen window curtain set thermal 100% blackout solid color panels
Energy efficient blackout curtain blocks out sunlight and harmful UV rays, reduces outside noise, and ensures total privacy
Measurements: 1 Swag Valance - 54"x15" and 2 tires / panels - each tier 27"x36". Rod Pocket insert can fit up to 1.5"-inch rod
Easy care: machine wash cold, do not bleach, hang to dry. Due to differences in computer monitors, there will be variations between the actual product and your screen
description: Beth is a 3 piece energy-efficient blackout kitchen curtain set by Kashi Home. It features a rod pocket top that fits a standard curtain rod. This kitchen curtain set consists of 1 panel of 54 inches x 15 inches and 2 panels of 27 inches x 36 inches. Available in solid colors - Beige, Orange, Turquoise, Chocolate, Sage, Taupe, Cloud, and Ruby. Made of soft polyester fabric. Easy care instruction - machine wash cold. Do not bleach. Hang to dry.
